brief.headline: Push PIK PLASTICS to match TPAC's ₹7.62/NOS on PET bottles — worth ₹8.48 L/year — and qualify Mold-Tek or Manjushree as a second source.

priceAsk.summary: Cut the price on PET BOT AMBER 250ML to ₹7.62/NOS (from ₹8.49) — the price TPAC already gives us for the same bottle.
priceAsk.target: ₹7.62/NOS on PET BOT AMBER 250ML/28MM WITH SHR SL 01; total saving ₹8.48 L per year
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹7.62/NOS to TPAC Packaging India Pvt Ltd. for this exact bottle. PIK's ₹8.49 is 11.5% higher. No reason we should pay two prices for the same thing.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days after receipt — already fair for a private vendor.

brief.financialLeverage: PIK PLASTICS publishes no financials, so we have no window into their cash position, revenue or how big a customer we are to them. That means we lean on what we do know: we're paying ₹8.48 L more than we should, and four credible alternates exist — two of them giants (Mold-Tek ₹946.50 Cr revenue, Manjushree ₹2569.83 Cr) who can absorb our ₹1.92 Cr spend easily. With no transparency from PIK and strong backups in hand, we can push hard on price and insist on a second source without worrying we'll lose supply.

evidence.point: We pay PIK ₹8.49/NOS for PET BOT AMBER 250ML; TPAC gives us ₹7.62/NOS for the same bottle — an 11.5% gap
This price gap costs us ₹7.19 L per year on that one bottle SKU alone
Total overpay across all rigid plastic packaging from PIK is ₹8.48 L per year
Our annual spend with PIK is ₹1.92 Cr — material volume to move if they won't match
PIK does not publish financial statements — we have no visibility into their health or capacity

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue), does pharma bottles and caps — top second-source candidate, strong enough (health B 65/100) to cover our full ₹1.92 Cr spend.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue), pharma-focused, health B (73/100) — robust and proven alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle specialist (Pearlpet brand, ₹19.83 Cr revenue) — direct fit for our PET bottles, though smaller and weaker (health D 24/100), so best as a niche backup.

risks: PIK's lack of public financials means we can't see if they're fragile — pushing too hard could lose the source without warning; qualify a second supplier in parallel.
TPAC's ₹7.62 price is our internal benchmark, not a market quote — if PIK pushes back, have TPAC confirm they can take more volume at that rate before we walk.
Mold-Tek and Manjushree are much bigger players — they may want higher minimums or longer lead-times than PIK; confirm MOQ and delivery fit before making them your main threat.
If PIK won't move on the big PET bottle (₹7.19 L/yr), lock in the smaller win on the BRUT 250ML (₹1.29 L/yr gap to ₹5.24/NOS from Suraj Blow Plast) to show you're serious.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹8.49 for a bottle that costs us ₹7.62 elsewhere — we need to talk about closing that gap and making sure we have a backup supplier qualified.
